messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time clock access, so I can’t give you the exact current time right now.  
New York City is in the Eastern Time Zone (UTC‑4 during daylight‑saving time, which is in effect in June). To find the precise time, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, your phone’s clock, or a smart assistant.
message.reasoning: User asks: "What is the current time in New York City?" We need to provide current time. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate using UTC offset. But we need to be accurate. We could use a function to get current time? There's no function for time. We can approximate: New York is UTC-4 during daylight saving time (EDT). But we don't know if DST is in effect. As of June 20, 2026, DST is in effect. So UTC-4. We need current UTC time. We don't have that. We could approximate by saying "I don't have real-time data" and suggest checking a reliable source. That might be best.
